title: Applicability.
bodyText: This chapter applies to all legal material in an electronic record that is designated as official under section 98-4 and first published electronically on or after [July 1, 2013].
bodyHtml: [§98-3]  Applicability.  This chapter applies to all legal material in an electronic record that is designated as official under section 98-4 and first published electronically on or after [July 1, 2013]. [L 2013, c 11, pt of §1]
